issues.description: Negated condition reads awkwardly and could be expressed more clearly
issues.detail: The new check `!(nodeName === 'layer' && typeof node.nodes === 'undefined')` inverts a compound condition inline. A clearer form like `(nodeName !== 'layer' || node.nodes !== undefined)` matches the style of the surrounding `!==` chain and reduces cognitive load. Behavior is identical but readability suffers in a hot rule-walk path.

issues.description: Missing test coverage for `@layer foo, bar;` statement form (no block)
issues.detail: The fix distinguishes block-form vs statement-form layers via `typeof node.nodes === 'undefined'`. A test confirms the block form is flagged, but there is no new test asserting the statement form (`@layer foo;` or `@layer foo, bar;` before `@import`) is still allowed. Without it, a future refactor could regress the carve-out silently.

PostCSS containers expose `.nodes` as an array when a block exists and as `undefined` otherwise. `node.nodes === undefined` (or `'nodes' in node`) is the more idiomatic check in this codebase and avoids the `typeof` guard typically reserved for possibly-undeclared identifiers.

issues.description: Changeset wording omits trailing period and rule code formatting consistency check
issues.detail: Other changesets in this repo typically end the line with a period and wrap rule names in backticks consistently. The new entry wraps the rule name in backticks (good) but verify the punctuation style matches recent minor entries to keep the generated CHANGELOG uniform.

issues.description: Consider nested `@layer` with empty block edge case
issues.detail: `@layer outer { @layer inner {} } @import ...;` — the outer layer has `nodes` defined (the inner layer), so it is treated as a block layer and correctly flags the import. Worth a confirming test since nested layers are a known authoring pattern and the boundary behavior is now load-bearing on `node.nodes`.

review.summary: The fix correctly distinguishes block-form `@layer` (which establishes a cascade context and should invalidate subsequent `@import`) from statement-form `@layer` (which only declares layer order and is permitted before imports), matching the CSS Cascade Layers spec. The implementation is minimal and the added test covers the primary regression. Main concerns are readability of the negated compound condition and missing explicit coverage for the still-allowed statement form and nested-layer edge case. No correctness blockers; safe to merge after small polish.
